meta.listDescription: The 99 Names of Allah in the order narrated by Tirmidhi: Arabic script, meanings, explanations, verses from the Qur'an and reflections.

list.title: The 99 Names of Allah
list.intro: Each Name has its own page with its meaning, an explanation, verses from the Qur'an, a reflection and today's practice.
list.order: The order follows the narration of Tirmidhi.

app.title: One Name every day, with a reminder
app.body: Inner Hunt brings you one Name each day; over 99 days every Name comes once. A daily reminder calls you back to the Name of the day at the time you choose. Pick how you feel, and it shows a Name suited to that feeling.
